description: A 50 x 50 leg splayed 100 mm in X over 700 mm, ending on the underside of a 100 x 40 rail (its top node sits on the rail's span). The leg leans atan(100 / 700) = 8.13 degrees and keeps its faces square to the frame (the leg's +v face looks along Y), so its top cut is a plain 8.13 degree miter with the top face up. The rail's underside is at z = 680; along the axis the cut is at (680 -/+ 25 x sin 8.13) / cos 8.13 = (680 -/+ 3.536) / 0.98995 = 683.3 / 690.5. The bottom end is free and square.
